title: On symmetries of hyperbolic lattices of large rank
summary: For an even, integral hyperbolic lattice $L$, the symmetry group of $L$ is the quotient of the group of isometries of $L$ by the Weyl subgroup of $(-2)$-reflections. Following Nikulin, the exceptional lattice of $L$ is defined as the sublattice generated by elements that have finite orbit under the symmetry group of $L$. We prove that every hyperbolic lattice of rank at least $46$ has trivial exceptional lattice. In particular, every such lattice admits a symmetry of maximal Salem degree.
